name: @peerloom/host
description: Shared library-host substrate for PeerLoom apps: brandable wire protocol, auth gate, host-local grant store, pairing and presence. Extracted from PearTune.
comment:no-overrides: This package runs in NODE ON A SERVER, not in a Bare worklet on a phone, so @peerloom/core's native-addon `overrides` block does NOT apply and must not be copied here. That block exists because iOS links native addons by exact framework version and any drift is ADDON_NOT_FOUND at launch. No iOS, no trap. Stated explicitly so nobody cargo-cults it in, and so nobody assumes it is safe when a future phone-side extraction happens.
